settings.question: What does taking a Dandy capsule feel like?
settings.answer: Most people describe a warm, soothing release of tension across their lower back, knees, and joints within about 45 minutes. The constant background ache of physical wear quiets down so moving feels natural again. Unlike sedating remedies, Dandy does not cause heavy eyelids or brain fog. Your mind stays clear, sharp, and alert while your body feels loose and comfortable.

settings.question: Which strength should I start with, 50 mg or 90 mg?
settings.answer:
If you are new to kratom extract, or dealing with everyday physical stiffness from desk work, gardening, or moderate daily wear, start with 50 mg. One 50 mg capsule is the ideal baseline for most adults.

If you have persistent, heavy physical ache, work demanding twelve hour shifts on your feet, or need stronger support for heavier days or bigger bodies, choose 90 mg. Either way, always start with a single capsule and a full glass of water.

settings.question: How quickly does it work, and how long does it last?
settings.answer: The vegan plant shell dissolves in your stomach in about ten minutes. Most people feel physical ease spreading through their joints and muscles within 40 to 45 minutes, slightly faster on an empty stomach. The physical comfort and clear focus generally last four to six hours, tapering off smoothly with zero afternoon crash and no rebound stiffness.

settings.question: What is in each capsule, and is it tested?
settings.answer:
A strictly minimalist formula: pure Mitragyna speciosa leaf extract standardized to an exact 50 mg or 90 mg of natural mitragynine, microcrystalline cellulose (a natural plant fiber for smooth absorption), and a vegan plant capsule shell.

Zero sugar, zero gelatin, zero synthetic additives, and zero calories. Every batch is independently tested by accredited American laboratories for exact alkaloid potency, heavy metals, pesticides, and microbial purity. The batch number on your jar links directly to its lab report online.

settings.question: Is Dandy legal, and how is it different from 7-OH products?
settings.answer:
Yes, Dandy is federally legal and protected for adult purchase across the United States. A growing number of states, including Utah, Arizona, Georgia, Florida, Texas, and Colorado, have passed the Kratom Consumer Protection Act to secure adult access to pure, tested leaf products.

Dandy contains exclusively natural, unadulterated Southeast Asian leaf extract centered on mitragynine. It is completely different from chemically altered or synthetic 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH) pills and gas station shots. We never alter, concentrate 7-OH, or spike our products.

settings.question: Can I take Dandy capsules every day?
settings.answer: Like coffee, alcohol, or THC, botanical products require adult responsibility and intentional use. While Dandy can be taken as part of a regular routine, we recommend using it when your body actually asks for relief, like after heavy physical shifts or hard yard work. Taking one or two rest days each week keeps your body responsive so a single capsule continues delivering the same steady ease.

settings.question: Who are Dandy capsules for, and who should avoid them?
settings.answer:
Dandy is designed for healthy adults 21 and older dealing with persistent physical wear, joint stiffness, and muscular fatigue who want dependable relief without stomach upset or mental fog.

Dandy is not intended for anyone under 21, women who are pregnant or nursing, or anyone with serious underlying medical conditions. If you are taking prescription medications, always speak with your physician before introducing any new botanical supplement.

settings.question: What if Dandy does not relieve my physical discomfort?
settings.answer: You are protected by our 30-day money-back guarantee. If you do not experience noticeable relief in your joints and muscles, simply contact our support team within 30 days and send the remaining jar back. We will refund every cent of your purchase price immediately.

settings.question: How is Dandy different from raw kratom powder?
settings.answer:
Raw leaf powder requires drinking or swallowing grams of unrefined, bitter plant dirt that frequently causes nausea and stomach bloat. On top of that, crude ground powder varies wildly in potency from bag to bag.

Dandy uses a specialized clean extraction process that separates pure mitragynine from the indigestible plant fibers. You get an exact, laboratory-measured dose in one small, tasteless capsule that goes down in seconds with zero stomach irritation.

settings.question: Will Dandy show up on a drug test?
settings.answer: Standard drug screens do not look for mitragynine. Mitragynine is an active botanical alkaloid that is chemically distinct from the substances tested on standard employment screens. Common 5-panel, 10-panel, and 12-panel workplace drug tests screen for opioids, amphetamines, cannabinoids, cocaine, and phencyclidine. Natural mitragynine does not trigger a positive result on those standard panels. If your employer runs specialized expanded botanical screenings, check their specific policy.
